name: Sergeant Eddison

facts.text: Every named of the Hall takes no damage once drawn past its tether, and walks back to its post.

story: Sergeant Eddison kept the duty roster of the watch and knew every man's post by heart, which is why the corruption kept him nearest the middle of the Hall: a dead watch still needs someone to know where everyone stands. He walks between the posts as he did in life, checking, and he raises the alarm when he finds a stranger where a watchman ought to be. When the riders came from Camelot, the dead at this post turned to watch them go, and have watched the door ever since.
legend: Another 5,000-health sergeant. He sits in the middle of the Hall, so pull him carefully or you wake the posts around him. Kill him where he stands; dragged off his post he cannot be hurt. The watch fights better together: clear the posts nearest it first.

aggro: You are not on the roster.

lairEntry: Someone has been checking every post. Recently.
atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Sergeant Eddison is released from the watch.
